svg.title: The connection cancels a false change
svg.desc: The partial derivative of the radial vector component is minus sine theta; its Christoffel correction is plus sine theta. This is an exact calculation on the flat polar plane. The derivative direction is θ. The full indexed equation in the chapter identifies the single connection coefficient used in this cancellation.

g.text: 12 / THE CONNECTION CANCELS A FALSE CHANGE
Polar components of an eastward unit vector
Partial change + basis correction = zero covariant change.
